title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
source: Frieren manga by Kanehito Yamada and Tsukasa Abe (ongoing). Snapshots use the latest published arc.
world: After the hero Himmel's party defeats the Demon King, the elf mage Frieren outlives her friends and realises she barely knew them. Decades later she travels north with her apprentice Fern and the warrior Stark, retracing the old journey toward Aureole, where souls are said to rest. A quiet, gentle fantasy about time, memory and small kindnesses, with sharp battles against demons.
power_system: Mages cast spells learned from grimoires; mana can be hidden or shown. Zoltraak, once a demon's killing spell, is now basic offensive magic. First-Class Mages are certified by the Continental Magic Association. Demons use human speech to deceive.
